Strata port uses the warper and touch tracker. Upstream Logos injection, fixed120Hz synchronizer and overlay are not loaded. Port modifications add configurable presentation duration, offscreen benchmark output and GPU-completion callbacks, and remove jailbreak resource paths. See FrameGeneration/.
